decisions.reason: The conferencing service is complementary to the firm's managed communications and still meets enterprise demand.
The metro data centre connection network has demonstrated adoption and fits the firm's core connectivity strategy.
Optical spectrum connectivity supports high-bandwidth, software-defined infrastructure and was featured prominently.
The voice number ordering portal improves digital self-service and operational efficiency for customers.
Carrier pre-selection telephony is a legacy service with declining demand and less strategic fit, but still has some customer base.
Direct voice network connection serves enterprise voice needs and remains relevant to the firm's voice portfolio.
